todos.content: Write the coaching cards and render your forehand
Sum up what to work on

summary: I found 17 rallies and cut the best 5 into a 40 s reel. Your forehand topspin: elbow about 130° and knees about 157° at contact, stance 1.75x shoulder width. Work on: Load low, lift through, end high. Then: Shadow 20 swings in a mirror, checking each cue.

outputs.title: Forehand topspin breakdown
outputs.summary: Load low. Swing up through it.
